links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of LLM responses versus human expert responses on the same questions
links.effect: Quality: Expert + AI 4.16, GPT-4 4.04, GPT-3.5 3.99, Claude 3.6, Expert 3.56, Bard 3.5, Bing 3.04; differences significant (P<0.0001).
